author: The Infographics Show
description:
AI promises a future where everything becomes cheaper, faster, and more abundant. But capitalism has a problem. Businesses need customers.

This video explores what could happen if artificial intelligence and automation replace workers faster than the economy can create new roles for them. Companies may save billions on labor, but if fewer people earn wages, who is left with enough money to buy what automated factories produce?
From Amazon warehouse robots and self-driving vehicles to AI replacing white-collar work, the relationship between productivity and employment is already changing. One proposed solution is Universal Basic Income. A guaranteed payment designed to keep consumers spending even if traditional jobs disappear. But that raises another question. What happens when your income no longer comes from work, but from a system controlled by governments or corporations?

title: Why the AI Boom Will Break Capitalism
